grw.help: Time of flight and mobility from the graph random walk: mean hitting times of the sink region from a sparse linear solve (no sampling), Chen, van der Hoorn, Baumeier, arXiv:2405.15836

field.help: External electric field; for detailed balance (symmetric solver) it must be along the transport normal

numberofcarriers.help: Number of carriers with site exclusion; the state space has n^N/N! states, so 1 or 2

observable.help: Two carriers: first = time until the first carrier reaches the sink (as in arXiv:2405.15836); transit = mean transit time per carrier, carriers removed at the sink (ToF transient). Identical for one carrier

maxstates.help: Two carriers: largest number of pair states (memory guard)

solver.help: Linear solver. auto: with detailed balance Cholesky (up to directlimit unknowns) or conjugate gradients on the symmetrized generator, otherwise LU or BiCGSTAB

directlimit.help: auto: largest number of unknowns for the direct solvers

tolerance.help: Relative residual of the iterative solvers; must be tight because trap modes dominate the hitting times

maxiterations.help: Iteration limit of the iterative solvers

sourcefile.help: Output: mean hitting time and its standard deviation per source segment (empty: none)

resultfile.help: Output: main results as 'key value unit' lines (empty: none)

occupationfile.help: Output: expected time spent on each segment (where the time of flight is spent; empty: none)
